_comment: Example spec for the GaAs worked example (doc/hybrid/05-worked-example.md).
Paths are relative to this file's directory: copy it into the GaAs-WANN case
directory, or run with --root /path/to/GaAs-WANN.  The DFT reference is the
WIEN2k band structure on a k-path: in a copy of the case directory named
dft_band/, put the path in GaAs-WANN.klist_band and run `x lapw1 -band`; keep
the resulting GaAs-WANN.energy and the .klist_band there.  The model is the
Wannier90 run of the worked example in hybF/ (write_hr = true, write_tb or
use_ws_distance as in the .win; GaAs-hybF_wsvec.dat is used when present).
eta_windows gives the index-paired RMS over each window (meV) in the .txt.
